This email is regarding the billing contact for your account (Customer ID: **C-7407**). We’ve been advised that invoices are being sent to an outdated contact (**ap-desk-tn8b@fabrikam.co**). To resolve this, please provide the following details of the **new billing contact** for future invoices:

Thank you,
The Fabrikam Support Team
**Ticket Reference: C-7407**
